title: Spacious Private Suite near Downtown Nashville
description:
Spacious entirely PRIVATE suite with own entrance, bathroom and parking located 4.8 miles from downtown Broadway Nashville and 5.7 miles to the airport (both a 10 minute drive). Ten minute drive to family-friendly activities, nightlife, Nashville International Airport, Grand Ole Opry, Opryland, Music Valley Drive (Nashville Palace etc) Downtown, Nissan Stadium, Bridgestone Arena, Ascend Amphitheatre. Great for couples, solo adventurers, business travelers, and families. Hope to see you soon!

The space
The room and bathroom are an extension to the back of our house. They are both completely private with own entrance. The space is large and can easily accommodate four adults or family. Off-street Parking is available for one car. $10 extra per night per person after 2 guests.

Guest access
Guests are welcome to use/ walk around the yard during daylight. No access the main house. Parking for one car available on the driveway - please park up to fence and to the right.

Other things to note
We are quite close to the airport so occasional air traffic noise (but not at all loud).
